name: Feedback CLI Command
description: Add 'stigmergy feedback <id> [helpful|already_knew|wrong|irrelevant]' command to the CLI. Validates feedback_id exists in recorded findings, validates rating is an allowed value, writes the feedback entry to .stigmergy/feedback.jsonl, prints confirmation, and handles errors with clear messages. Three-layer architecture: data models (primitives/feedback.py), domain functions (cli/feedback_cmd.py), and thin CLI layer. Duplicate policy: append-only, downstream consumers (calibration.py) take the latest entry per feedback_id. Rating input is case-insensitive.

types.name: FeedbackRating
types.description: Allowed feedback rating values. Implemented as StrEnum so each variant serializes to its lowercase string value. Rating input from CLI is normalized to lowercase before matching.

types.name: FeedbackEntry

fields.name: feedback_id
fields.description: The unique identifier of the finding being rated. Must correspond to an existing finding in the stigmergy findings store.

validators.error_message: feedback_id must be a non-empty string

fields.name: rating
fields.description: The user's rating of the finding.

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: UTC-aware ISO 8601 timestamp of when the feedback was recorded. Represented as datetime internally but serialized as ISO 8601 string in the JSONL output. Must include timezone info (always UTC).

validators.error_message: timestamp must be a UTC-aware ISO 8601 datetime string

types.description: A single feedback record to be appended to feedback.jsonl. Frozen (immutable) Pydantic v2 BaseModel with ConfigDict(frozen=True). Serialized as a single JSON line when written to the JSONL file.

types.name: FeedbackError

fields.name: message
fields.description: Human-readable error message suitable for display to the user.

types.description: Base error type for all feedback-related errors. Serves as the root of the error hierarchy. CLI layer catches this type to handle all feedback errors uniformly.

types.name: FeedbackIdNotFoundError

fields.name: message
fields.description: Human-readable error message including the unrecognized feedback_id.

fields.name: feedback_id
fields.description: The feedback_id that was not found.

types.description: Raised when the given feedback_id does not correspond to any recorded finding in the stigmergy findings store. Subtype of FeedbackError.

types.name: InvalidFeedbackRatingError

fields.name: message
fields.description: Human-readable error message including the invalid rating and the list of allowed values.

fields.name: rating_given
fields.description: The raw rating string that was rejected.

fields.name: allowed_ratings
fields.description: The list of valid FeedbackRating values.

types.description: Raised when the rating string does not match any variant of FeedbackRating (after case-insensitive normalization). Subtype of FeedbackError.

types.name: FeedbackRatingList
types.description: A list of FeedbackRating string values.

types.name: FindingsStore

fields.name: stigmergy_dir
fields.description: Filesystem path to the .stigmergy directory containing findings data. Represented as pathlib.Path internally.

types.description: Protocol (structural typing interface) for looking up whether a finding exists by its ID. Default implementation reads from .stigmergy/findings.jsonl. Implementations must be async-compatible. This enables testing with in-memory stores.

types.name: ValidationResult

fields.name: found
fields.description: Whether the feedback_id was found in the findings store.

types.description: Result of feedback_id validation. Used internally; not persisted.

types.name: CLIExitCode
types.description: Exit codes used by the CLI layer when handling feedback commands. Maps error types to numeric exit codes for scripting/automation compatibility.

functions.name: validate_feedback_id
functions.description: Checks whether the given feedback_id exists in the recorded findings store (default: .stigmergy/findings.jsonl). Reads the findings file using asyncio.to_thread for non-blocking I/O. Raises FeedbackIdNotFoundError if the ID is not found. Returns None on success (validation passed).

inputs.name: stigmergy_dir
inputs.description: Path to the .stigmergy directory. Must exist and contain findings.jsonl.

error_cases.name: id_not_found
error_cases.condition: No finding with the given feedback_id exists in findings.jsonl

error_data.feedback_id: The feedback_id that was not found

error_cases.name: findings_file_missing
error_cases.condition: The findings.jsonl file does not exist at the expected path within stigmergy_dir

error_cases.name: findings_file_unreadable
error_cases.condition: The findings.jsonl file exists but cannot be read (permissions, corruption, etc.)

preconditions: stigmergy_dir points to an existing directory
postconditions: If the function returns without error, the feedback_id exists in the findings store
No mutations are made to the findings store or filesystem

functions.name: parse_feedback_rating
functions.description: Parses and validates a raw rating string into a FeedbackRating enum value. Performs case-insensitive matching (e.g., 'Helpful' -> 'helpful'). Raises InvalidFeedbackRatingError if the string does not match any variant.

inputs.name: rating_str
inputs.description: The raw rating string from CLI input.

error_cases.name: invalid_rating
error_cases.condition: rating_str (lowercased) does not match any FeedbackRating variant

error_data.rating_given: The raw string that was provided

postconditions: Return value is one of: helpful, already_knew, wrong, irrelevant
No side effects

functions.name: record_feedback
functions.description: Appends a FeedbackEntry as a single JSON line to .stigmergy/feedback.jsonl. Uses asyncio.to_thread wrapping synchronous file I/O (stdlib preference, no aiofiles dependency). Creates the feedback.jsonl file if it does not exist. Creates intermediate directories if stigmergy_dir does not exist. Returns the absolute path of the file written to.

error_cases.name: write_permission_denied
error_cases.condition: The process lacks write permissions to stigmergy_dir or feedback.jsonl

error_cases.name: disk_full
error_cases.condition: The filesystem has insufficient space to append the entry

error_data.message: Failed to write feedback entry: disk full or I/O error

preconditions: entry is a valid FeedbackEntry (all fields populated, timestamp is UTC)
The process has write permissions to stigmergy_dir or its parent
postconditions: feedback.jsonl exists at stigmergy_dir/feedback.jsonl
The last line of feedback.jsonl is the JSON serialization of entry
The file ends with a newline character
Return value is the absolute path to feedback.jsonl
Pre-existing content of feedback.jsonl is preserved (append-only)
No other files are created or modified
side_effects: May create {stigmergy_dir} directory if it does not exist
May create feedback.jsonl file if it does not exist

functions.name: handle_feedback
functions.description: Top-level orchestrator for the feedback workflow. Validates the feedback_id against recorded findings, parses and validates the rating string (case-insensitive), creates a FeedbackEntry with a UTC timestamp, writes it to feedback.jsonl, and returns the created entry. This is the primary entry point called by the CLI layer.

inputs.name: feedback_id
inputs.description: The finding identifier to provide feedback on.

inputs.name: rating
inputs.description: The raw rating string from user input. Will be normalized to lowercase for matching.

inputs.name: stigmergy_dir
inputs.description: Path to the .stigmergy directory. Defaults to '.stigmergy' relative to CWD.

error_cases.name: id_not_found
error_cases.condition: feedback_id does not match any recorded finding

error_cases.name: invalid_rating
error_cases.condition: rating string does not match any FeedbackRating variant after case normalization

error_cases.name: io_error
error_cases.condition: File I/O fails during validation or recording (missing findings file, permissions, disk full)

preconditions: stigmergy_dir contains a valid findings.jsonl with recorded findings
The process has read permissions on findings.jsonl and write permissions on stigmergy_dir
postconditions: A new FeedbackEntry has been appended to {stigmergy_dir}/feedback.jsonl
The returned FeedbackEntry has feedback_id matching the input
The returned FeedbackEntry has a rating that is a valid FeedbackRating
The returned FeedbackEntry has a UTC-aware timestamp no earlier than invocation time
Duplicate feedback for the same feedback_id is allowed (append-only policy)
side_effects: May create {stigmergy_dir} directory and/or feedback.jsonl file

functions.name: register_feedback_command
functions.description: Registers the 'feedback' subcommand with the CLI argument parser. Configures two positional arguments: <id> (feedback_id) and <rating>. Binds the subcommand handler to invoke handle_feedback, catch FeedbackError subtypes, print user-friendly messages to stderr, and return the appropriate CLIExitCode. This is the thin CLI layer that contains no business logic.

inputs.name: parser
inputs.description: The CLI subparsers object (argparse._SubParsersAction or equivalent) to register the feedback subcommand on.

preconditions: parser is a valid argparse subparsers action object
No 'feedback' subcommand is already registered on this parser
postconditions: A 'feedback' subcommand is registered on the parser
The subcommand accepts two positional arguments: id (str) and rating (str)
The subcommand handler calls handle_feedback and maps errors to exit codes
side_effects: Mutates the parser object by adding a 'feedback' subcommand

functions.name: run_feedback_command
functions.description: CLI entry point handler invoked when 'stigmergy feedback <id> <rating>' is executed. Calls handle_feedback, prints a human-readable confirmation on success (to stdout), catches FeedbackError subtypes and prints formatted error messages to stderr, and returns the appropriate CLIExitCode integer value. This is the async-to-sync bridge for the CLI layer.

inputs.name: feedback_id
inputs.description: The finding ID argument from the CLI.

inputs.name: rating
inputs.description: The rating argument from the CLI.

error_cases.name: unexpected_error
error_cases.condition: An unexpected exception occurs outside the FeedbackError hierarchy

preconditions: Called from CLI argument dispatch with parsed positional arguments
postconditions: Return value is 0 on success, 1 for FeedbackIdNotFoundError, 2 for InvalidFeedbackRatingError, 3 for I/O FeedbackError, 4 for unexpected errors
On success: confirmation message printed to stdout including feedback_id and rating
On error: error message printed to stderr
side_effects: Delegates to handle_feedback which appends to feedback.jsonl

invariants: FeedbackRating has exactly four variants: helpful, already_knew, wrong, irrelevant
FeedbackEntry is immutable (frozen Pydantic model) once created
FeedbackEntry.timestamp is always UTC-aware (timezone-aware with UTC offset)
feedback.jsonl is append-only; entries are never modified or deleted
Multiple feedback entries for the same feedback_id are allowed; downstream consumers (calibration.py) take the latest entry per feedback_id
Rating input from CLI is matched case-insensitively (normalized to lowercase before comparison)
All file I/O is performed via asyncio.to_thread wrapping synchronous stdlib I/O (no aiofiles dependency)
FeedbackError is the base exception type; FeedbackIdNotFoundError and InvalidFeedbackRatingError are subtypes
The CLI layer contains no business logic; all validation and persistence logic resides in domain functions
Each line in feedback.jsonl is a complete, self-contained JSON object (FeedbackEntry serialization)
